features.name: Mississippi River (Fort Madison)
features.blurb: Crossing the Mississippi on the BNSF swing bridge at Fort Madison, IA.

features.name: Flint Hills tallgrass prairie
features.blurb: The last great expanse of tallgrass prairie, rolling across the Kansas Flint Hills.

features.name: Western High Plains
features.blurb: The short-grass High Plains of western Kansas and southeastern Colorado, climbing imperceptibly toward the Rockies.

features.name: Raton Pass
features.blurb: The route's high point — over the Sangre de Cristos on the CO/NM line via the Raton Tunnel; sweeping 2% grades.

features.name: Glorieta Pass
features.blurb: Climbing through the southern Sangre de Cristos toward Lamy and Santa Fe.

features.name: Continental Divide (Campbell Pass)
features.blurb: Crossing the Continental Divide on the high New Mexico plateau near Gallup.

features.name: Colorado Plateau (Northern Arizona)
features.blurb: Red-rock high desert of the Colorado Plateau — Painted Desert country across northern Arizona.

features.name: Mojave Desert
features.blurb: Crossing the Mojave between Needles and Barstow — Joshua trees and open desert.

features.name: Cajon Pass
features.blurb: The dramatic descent off the high desert through Cajon Pass into the Los Angeles basin.

features.name: San Gorgonio Pass (Palm Springs windmills)
features.blurb: Out of the LA basin past the wind farms of San Gorgonio Pass, between San Jacinto and San Bernardino peaks.

features.name: Colorado Desert / Salton Basin
features.blurb: The below-sea-level Colorado Desert and Salton Sea basin east of the LA basin.

features.name: Colorado River (Yuma)
features.blurb: Crossing the Colorado River at Yuma — the Arizona–California line.

features.name: Sonoran Desert
features.blurb: Saguaro country — the Sonoran Desert between Yuma and Tucson.

features.name: Rio Grande / El Paso border
features.blurb: Running the Rio Grande along the US–Mexico border at El Paso, with Ciudad Juárez across the river.

features.name: West Texas / Big Bend country
features.blurb: The vast Chihuahuan Desert and mountains around Alpine and Marathon — gateway to Big Bend.

features.name: Pecos River High Bridge
features.blurb: One of the highest railroad bridges in Texas — soaring over the Pecos River canyon west of Del Rio.

features.name: Louisiana Gulf Coastal Plain
features.blurb: Rice prairies, bayous and the coastal plain of southwest Louisiana.

features.name: Atchafalaya Basin
features.blurb: The great Atchafalaya swamp — miles of cypress, bayou and water on the causeway into Cajun country.

features.name: Lake Pontchartrain crossing
features.blurb: Leaving New Orleans north across the Lake Pontchartrain trestle — open water on both sides.

features.name: Mississippi Piney Woods
features.blurb: The pine forests and small towns of southern Mississippi between the Gulf coast and the Delta.

features.name: Mississippi Delta
features.blurb: The flat, fertile Mississippi Delta — cotton country and the birthplace of the blues.

features.name: Mississippi River at Memphis
features.blurb: Running the bluff above the Mississippi at Memphis — the big river wide to the west.

features.name: Ohio River (near Cairo)
features.blurb: Crossing the Ohio River near its confluence with the Mississippi at the tip of Illinois.

features.name: Central Illinois prairie
features.blurb: The corn-and-soybean prairie of central Illinois, rolling north toward Chicago.

features.name: Wisconsin Dells
features.blurb: Sandstone gorges and rock formations along the Wisconsin River.

features.name: Upper Mississippi River
features.blurb: Hugging the Upper Mississippi from La Crosse up through Winona — bluffs and backwaters out the west windows.

features.name: Minnesota Lakes & North Woods
features.blurb: The lakes, birch and pine of central Minnesota north of the Twin Cities.

features.name: Northern Great Plains
features.blurb: The wide open wheat country of North Dakota — big sky to every horizon.

features.name: Montana Hi-Line
features.blurb: The vast high plains of Montana's Hi-Line, running just south of the Canadian border toward the Rockies.

features.name: Marias Pass (Continental Divide)
features.blurb: Crossing the Continental Divide at Marias Pass on the southern boundary of Glacier — the lowest crossing of the northern Rockies.

features.name: Glacier National Park
features.blurb: Skirting the wild southern edge of Glacier — peaks of the park rising to the north between East and West Glacier.

features.name: Columbia River Gorge
features.blurb: Down the Columbia River Gorge to Portland — basalt cliffs and waterfalls, the river wide to the south.

features.name: Cascade Range crossing
features.blurb: Climbing the Oregon Cascades above Eugene through tall fir forest and snowsheds toward Cascade Summit.

features.name: Mount Shasta
features.blurb: The 14,179-ft volcanic cone of Mount Shasta looming to the east near Dunsmuir.

features.name: Upper Sacramento River Canyon
features.blurb: Twisting down the forested upper Sacramento River canyon beneath Mount Shasta.

features.name: Sacramento Valley
features.blurb: The broad farm country of California's Central Valley.

features.name: San Francisco Bay
features.blurb: Running the east shore of San Francisco Bay through Martinez and Oakland — water and the city skyline to the west.

features.name: Salinas Valley
features.blurb: Steinbeck's Salinas Valley — lettuce fields between the coastal ranges.

features.name: Pacific Coast (Gaviota)
features.blurb: The famous run right along the Pacific — empty beaches and surf out the west windows from San Luis Obispo to Santa Barbara.

features.name: Colorado River (Yuma)
features.blurb: Crossing the Colorado River at Yuma on the LA-to-San Antonio run.

features.name: Sonoran Desert (Arizona)
features.blurb: Saguaro-studded Sonoran Desert between Yuma and Tucson.

features.name: Pecos River High Bridge
features.blurb: Soaring over the Pecos River canyon west of Del Rio — one of Texas's highest rail bridges.

features.name: Texas Hill Country
features.blurb: Live-oak hills and the Balcones Escarpment between San Antonio and Austin.

features.name: East Texas Piney Woods
features.blurb: The pine forests of deep East Texas around Longview and Marshall.

features.name: Arkansas / Ozark foothills
features.blurb: Pine forests and the rolling foothills of the Ouachitas and Ozarks across Arkansas.

features.name: Missouri Ozarks
features.blurb: Wooded hills and clear streams of the Missouri Ozarks south of St. Louis.

features.name: Mississippi River into St. Louis
features.blurb: Crossing the Mississippi on the MacArthur Bridge into St. Louis, the Gateway Arch rising just upstream.

features.name: Central Illinois prairie
features.blurb: Lincoln's prairie — farm country through Springfield and Bloomington toward Chicago.
